impact.why.label: Why It Matters
impact.why.heading: Nopal changes what livestock feed costs the land.
impact.item1.d: Uses significantly less water than conventional feed crops like corn, helping reduce pressure on scarce water resources.
impact.item2.d: Captures carbon as it grows, contributing to climate change mitigation while producing valuable biomass.
impact.item3.d: Thrives under prolonged drought and extreme heat, remaining productive when many conventional feed crops struggle.
impact.item4.d: Grows on degraded and low-fertility land, creating productive agricultural value without competing for prime farmland.
impact.item5.d: Reduces clearing of forests for additional feed production.
impact.item6.d: Provides habitat to multiple species, stabilizes soil and serves as an important food and water source for wildlife in dryland ecosystems.
impact.item7.d: Provides a dependable source of nutritious biomass throughout the year, helping maintain livestock feed supplies when seasonal crops are unavailable.

about.header.label: About
about.header.heading: Our Story
about.story.label: Our Story
about.story.heading: Every great solution starts with a simple question.
about.story.quote: Why are livestock producers in some of the world's driest regions still dependent on imported feed crops that require so much water?
about.story.body: So we set out to transform the nopal cactus-one of nature's most resilient plants-into a complete livestock feed that addresses the challenges of drought, unstable feed supplies, and rising costs, while delivering the nutrition and protein animals need to thrive.

about.mexico.p3: Farmers already use nopal as supplemental forage

about.vision.title: Our Vision

sol.header.heading: A smarter way to feed livestock.
sol.header.sub: Climate-resilient livestock feed made from nopal cactus, with year-round availability at a competitive price.
sol.why.label: Why We Built Alidez
sol.why.heading: Livestock feed is changing.
sol.why.p1: As feed costs rise and climate pressures increase, producers need alternatives that are reliable, affordable, and locally produced.
sol.why.p2: Alidez transforms nopal cactus into a complete livestock feed designed to strengthen resilience without compromising performance.
sol.pellets.label: The Format
sol.pellets.heading: Why nopal pellets?
sol.pellets.1.d: Withstands prolonged drought and extreme heat, staying productive when conventional crops struggle.
sol.pellets.2.d: Needs far less water than conventional forage crops, easing pressure on scarce resources.
sol.pellets.3.d: Stable production across seasons, supporting a more dependable supply.
sol.pellets.4.d: Productive on degraded, low-fertility soil without competing for prime farmland.
sol.pellets.5.d: The pelletized format is shelf-stable, dense and simple to handle and move.
sol.pellets.6.d: Pellets are already standard, so producers don't need new equipment or new habits.
sol.process.label: How It's Made
sol.process.heading: From plant to feed
sol.process.body: Our proprietary formula transforms nopal cactus into a complete livestock feed designed to perform comparably to conventional feed, giving producers a more resilient and dependable feed source at a competitive price.
